issues.legal_issue: A person claiming relief under a separate transaction may be added as a defendant only if that person ought to have been joined or has a direct legal interest making their presence necessary for complete adjudication of the suit.
material_facts: The pending suit concerned the validity of an earlier transfer of controlling shares in companies, and a claim to possession of a tea estate through one of those companies.
The applicant sought specific performance of a later agreement for sale of the tea estate, in a separate suit.
The applicant had no direct legal interest in the validity of the earlier share-transfer agreement that was the subject of the pending suit.
The two suits were being tried together.
issues.conclusion: The applicant was not entitled to be added as a defendant. The order allowing impleadment was set aside and the order refusing it was restored.
issues.legal_principle: Under Order 1 Rule 10(2) of the Code of Civil Procedure, a person may be added if they ought to have been joined or their presence is necessary to enable the court to effectually and completely adjudicate and settle the questions in the suit. A direct legal interest, rather than an indirect or commercial interest, is required; preventing multiplicity of proceedings is not by itself the object of the rule. The court relied on Moser v. Marsden, Razia Begum v. Sahebzadi Anwar Begum, and Ramesh Hirachand Kundanmal v. Municipal Corporation of Greater Bombay.

predicates.party_addition_application_in_pending_su: A person applied to be added as a party to a pending suit.
predicates.applicant_lacks_direct_legal_interest: The applicant had no direct legal interest in the issues to be decided in the pending suit.
predicates.applicant_seeks_relief_on_separate_cause: The applicant sought relief based on a separate cause of action rather than an issue in the pending suit.

issues.definition: When a person applies to join a pending suit, lacks a direct legal interest in its issues, and seeks relief on a separate cause, that person is not added as a party.
